name: Campaign and geography remain functional
covers: historic map and basemap mode selection
description: Load campaign, pan/zoom and change map modes; verify the unchanged original battle view remains available.
steps: Open world map
Select SATELLITE and HISTORIC
Inspect Canusium and use original 3D inspect
Return to campaign
expected: Map and city markers render with fallback when external tiles fail, and the original 3D view is accessible.

name: Strategic city economy and persistent construction
covers: auto resolve fortification bonus only on defender owned location
description: Test economic and placement gameplay without touching battle engine.
steps: Enter Canusium city
Place and construct timber camp, return to campaign
Advance one day and check timber increases
Reenter city and confirm location persisted
Build wall at settlement perimeter and check local defence
expected: Resources and placement persist, production updates and the defense rating is local to the town.

name: City builder mobile and invalid placement protection
description: Validate mobile settlement interactions and prevent unsupported construction.
steps: Open Canusium on phone layout and enter city
Try placing a building in central forum or road tile
Try selecting a town controlled by Carthage
Check unaffordable building buttons disable
expected: Invalid or foreign-controlled placements do not spend resources; navigation is usable on mobile.

name: March logistics and truthful objective
description: March an army over multiple game days, inspecting movements and supply.
steps: Select Roman field army at Canusium
Issue multi-day march toward Luceria
Advance one day; troop icon remains between source and destination
Resolve a non-Cannae fight if possible and verify Cannae still contested
expected: Troop appears along the road and mission progress is not fabricated by an unrelated victory.

name: Campaign-to-battle export is non-invasive
description: Export a saved city battle brief for later Claude integration.
steps: Enter Canusium and build a wall
Return to campaign
Click export battle brief
Inspect JSON for city plan and defence values, approximate coordinates, and draft-only status
Load the preserved original 3D view and return
expected: Export contains actual saved structures but does not affect the 3D battle engine or pretend to have historical 3D terrain.
